evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py and its accompanying tests and docs.
rationale: Resolves a security vulnerability where revoked or expired keys counted toward binary verification quorums. As noted in the description, 'A verification run can therefore pass and report binaries as verified even if all supplied signatures come from compromised or defunct keys' (disclosed by Red Team), directly compromising the security of the verification tool.
